mappings.note: Both contain the superscription: 'For the choir director. For Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.'
Content matches perfectly regarding guarding ways and tongue while the wicked is present.
Matches: 'I was silent... even from good, but my pain grew worse.'
Matches: Heart burning within, meditation kindled fire, then spoke.
Matches: Request to know end and measure of days to understand transience.
Matches: Days as handbreadths, life as nothing, man like a breath. Includes 'Selah'.
Matches: Man walks like shadow, gathers but doesn't know who will get it.
Matches: 'What do I wait for? My hope is in you.'
Matches: Deliver from transgressions and not be a reproach to the fool.
Matches: Silent again because God did it.
Matches: Remove plague/pain, I am consumed by your hand's blow.
Matches: Chastening for sin consumes like a moth; man is breath. Includes 'Selah'.
Translation verse contains the plea to hear prayer and not be silent regarding tears (matching OSMAIN v13), but also includes additional text found in Translation Verse 14.

This verse contains content ('Turn from me that I may recover before I go and be no more') which is NOT present in the provided OSMAIN text (which ends at v13). This indicates a split or missing segment in the source mapping.

extraContent.description: The entire content of verse 14 ('הָשַׁע מִמֶּנִּי וְאַבְלִיגָה בְּטֶרֶם אֵלֵךְ וְאֵינֶנִּי' - 'Turn from me that I may recover before I go and be no more') is missing in the OSMAIN text provided. In standard Hebrew numbering, this is often part of verse 13 or a distinct final plea not captured in the Norwegian master text's v13.
